name: photodesk

scripts.//dev: Serves the page alone, for looking at chrome and layout. It cannot reach the Rust core, so no photograph will open and ipc.ts says exactly that. Running the application is `npm run build && cargo run -p photodesk-app`.

//: §10.3 froze zero runtime dependencies, and this is what that means in practice: `dependencies` is absent, not empty. Vite and TypeScript are build tooling and leave nothing in the bundle. Tauri's own JS API is reached through `withGlobalTauri` rather than @tauri-apps/api for the same reason — it would be the one runtime package, for a wrapper around a function the webview already has.
